_comment: ADR-0036. Reviewed record of objects declared DYNAMICALLY via EXECUTE format('... %I ...') fan-out loops, which static extraction cannot read. Keyed by 'kind::migration-filename'. Names are AS-CREATED by that file; later renames/drops (e.g. reference_team_functions -> reference_job_functions, DROP reference_roles, both in 20260503180621) are applied by the gate's event stream, so list what the loop literally creates. A %I fan-out with no entry here fails the gate closed (see check-db-schema-present.mjs).
